summary: # Marvelous Designer Tips: How to Use Pressure to Achieve Inflated Effects In this tutorial, we will demonstrate how pressure affects your outfit in Marvelous Designer. Understanding how to manipulate pressure values can enhance your designs, particularly when creating inflated effects like those found in down jackets. ## Understanding Pressure in Marvelous Designer The pressure value generates a constant force based on the front or back of the board. This is crucial for achieving the desired effects in your garments. ## Creating the Inner Line for the T-Shirt In this case, we will create an inner line for the T-shirt. After that, we will select the inner layer of the cologne to create the effect of a down jacket. ## Manipulating the Inner Layer The surface of the inner layer is turned over, becoming the front or back of the cologne layer. When the pressure is set to a positive value, the board receives a constant force from the front or back of the cologne layer. ## Achieving Pressure Balance Since the inner board is the opposite, it is now set to the same value to achieve pressure balance. Note that when I change the pressure value, the pressure effect becomes more subtle. ## Adjusting Negative Pressure Values Additionally, if the inner layer of the board is not turned over, we will set the pressure value of the inner layer of the board to a negative value to balance the pressure. ## Important Tips for Pressure Values Please ensure that the pressure values of the two layers (inner and outer) are the same to maintain proper pressure balance. This is essential for achieving the desired inflated effect in your designs. By following these steps, you can effectively utilize pressure in your designs to create stunning visual effects and bring your garments to life.
